# Selecting Specific Data

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## Selecting Specific Data

Sometimes, you don't need everything in a table—just a few specific columns.

For example, you only want demographic data, like the age and country columns, from the Customers table.

Instead of using * to select all columns, you can specify just the ones you need. Here's how:

```sql
1SELECT age, country
2FROM Customers;
```

Click Run Code to see the output. You'll notice only the age and country columns are displayed:

![Working of SQL SELECT Statement](data:image/png;base64,)
